sections.title: Overview
sections.body: Portfolio Overview provides a comprehensive view of all projects and services across the organization. **v5 Cluster F + E (Sessions F7 + E5 + E6) splits the module into two sibling sub-modules** via a top-level pill switcher (last selection persisted in URL): **Change Portfolio** (DoI 0–4 transformation projects with the existing dashboards, tabs, and tree) and **Run Portfolio** (DoI 5 / Offerings / Internal Services). On Change, three tabs are visible: Dashboard, Backlog (v5 ranked-intake replacement for the v4 Intake Queue), CR Approvals, and the new **External Spend** tab. On Run, a single dashboard surfaces 4 KPIs + 3 dimension rollup panels + a type-filtered entity list. Controllers and executives use this module to monitor portfolio health, review new submissions, and approve change requests. Tab visibility is role-based: the **Dashboard** is visible to all roles, the **Backlog** is visible to all roles (with Project Lead filtering to own projects), the **CR Approvals** tab is visible only to Controllers, and **External Spend** is read-only for all roles. Project clicks open a **full-page detail view** at `/portfolio/project/{id}` (replaces the v4 slide-in panel) with hierarchy breadcrumb + 4-tab shell (Overview / Financial Detail / Resources & Costs / History), all read-only for every role. The v4 `/api/portfolio/intake*` endpoints are retired in v5 and return HTTP 410 Gone with replacement pointers to `/api/intake/*`.

sections.title: Dashboard Tab
sections.body: The Dashboard shows a KPI summary row at the top (total budget, YTD spend, forecast-at-completion, variance, CapEx/OpEx split, Run/Change ratio), followed by a filter bar and the portfolio tree table. The tree is expandable following the active organizational hierarchy (e.g., Line of Business → Program → Project/Service). Each row shows RAG status, budget figures, and timeline. Click any project row to open a summary panel on the right.

sections.title: Portfolio Tree Navigation
sections.body: Expand top-level rows to see child entities and projects underneath. Aggregate values (budget, variance) roll up at each level. Use the filter bar to narrow by organizational hierarchy level, status, RAG color, cost center, or type (project vs service). Sort by any column header.

sections.title: Summary Panel
sections.body: Clicking a project opens a slide-in panel on the right showing RAG status, budget snapshot (baseline/forecast/actuals), timeline bar, last CR summary, and a forecast trend sparkline. Use the 'Open in Workbench' button to navigate to the full project detail in the Project Workbench module.

sections.title: Charts
sections.body: Three charts complement the table: Forecast by top-level entity (stacked bar), Forecast Trajectory (line chart showing how total forecast shifted over time), and RAG Distribution (donut chart). These update based on active filters.

sections.title: Backlog Tab (v5 Intake Replacement)
sections.body:
The Backlog tab replaces the v4 Intake Queue. Every project — proposed, approved, active — appears in a single ranked list with its DoI (Degree of Implementation, 0–5), pipeline stage (Proposed / Under Evaluation / Approved / Active / Hyper-maintenance / Operate / Retired / Paused / Cancelled), Tech Navigator scores, and within-cutoff flag.

**Creating a project:** `POST /api/intake/projects` lands the project at DoI 0 (Proposed). Lightweight metadata only; the project appears immediately at the bottom of the ranked list with composite score null until the Tech Navigator rubric is filled in.

**Controller actions on Under Evaluation projects:**
- **Approve** — moves to Approved (DoI 3), generates baseline, sets status to active.
- **Send Back** — returns to Proposed (DoI 1) with comments, captures a `controller_sent_back` snapshot, notifies the Project Lead with a deep link to the structured diff view.
- **Reject** — moves to Cancelled with reason captured; DoI is frozen.

**Send Back ↔ Resubmit cycle:** After a Send Back, the PL on their own project (or a Controller on any project) can edit the project and call Resubmit. The project moves back to Under Evaluation (DoI 2) and a `pl_resubmitted` snapshot is captured. The diff endpoint returns the structured before/after across the diffable subset (master data, Tech Navigator scores, milestone count).

**v4 deprecation:** the v4 `/api/portfolio/intake*` endpoints all return HTTP 410 Gone with `{error, message, replacements}` payloads pointing at the new `/api/intake/*` endpoints.

sections.title: CR Approvals Tab
sections.body:
Shows change requests pending controller review. Each row shows the project, CR summary, submitter, confirming CC Owner, and cost impact.

**Side Panel:** Click any CR row to open a detail panel showing the CR summary, status, category, justification, CC Owner confirmation, and a comparison grid with changed cells highlighted. Use 'Open Full Detail' for the full workspace view.

**Full Detail Workspace:** Shows the complete CR with header metadata, a read-only comparison grid (with Current, Proposed, and Delta columns), KPI strip (Affected Lines Current, Proposed, Total Impact), and justification.

**Controller Actions:**
- **Approve** — if the CR has internal resource changes, it routes to the CC Owner for resource confirmation before becoming approved. If no resource changes, it is approved directly and the forecast is updated.
- **Reject** — CR is rejected with a required reason.
- **Request Changes** — opens a full editable forecast grid where the controller can modify specific cells (hours for internal resources, amounts for external costs). Changed cells are highlighted in amber. The controller adds feedback text and sends back to the Project Lead with proposed modifications. A snapshot of the original and proposed values is saved for diff comparison.

sections.title: RAG Indicators
sections.body: Green means variance below 5%. Amber means 5-10%. Red means above 10%. The combined RAG takes the worst of budget RAG and timeline RAG. Hover over any RAG indicator to see the specific variance percentages.

sections.title: Run Portfolio Sub-Module
sections.body:
Toggle the Change/Run pill at the top of Portfolio Overview to switch into the Run Portfolio view (URL: `/portfolio?view=run`). The Run sub-module surfaces all DoI 5 entities — 2 Run-stage projects (Cloud Platform Run, Identity & Access Management Run), 6 Offerings (incl. the demo flagship **Master Data Hub** at S042), and 17 Internal Services — for a total of **25 chargeable entities** in the seed.

**4 KPIs across the top:**
- **Total Annual Cost** — own-cost + Σ(inflows) sum across all 25 entities (~€13.9M in the seed).
- **To-Business / Internal split** — what % of effective cost releases to-Business (Stage 2 BTC) vs flows back into the IT internal cost pool.
- **Mix by entity type** — `2 P · 6 O · 17 S` count.
- **Outsourcing ratio** — share of effective cost served via external offerings.

**3 dimension panels** below the KPIs show per-region / per-division / per-country effective cost rolled up across the 25 entities. Each row shows the entity-type breakdown (Offering / Project / InternalService) with absolute amounts and % of dimension total.

**Entity list** is type-filterable (All / Project / Offering / InternalService). Each row links into a slim **EntityWorkspace** at `/workbench?entity={id}&type={type}` whose primary tab is **BTC** (the equivalent of Workbench's Forecast & Planning for non-Project entities). For Project subtypes, the link still navigates to the full Workbench at `/workbench?project={id}`.

**Read-only emphasis:** the Run Portfolio is a viewing surface; cost-allocation editing happens in the **Charging & Allocations** module (`/charging`).

sections.title: External Spend Tab
sections.body:
New tab on the Change Portfolio (visible to all roles, read-only). Aggregates external (vendor) spend across the entire Change portfolio so finance can see vendor concentration without drilling into each project.

**Top KPI strip:** Total external forecast / actuals YTD / open POs / variance vs baseline.

**Cross-project vendor summary:** sortable table — vendor name, total spend across all projects, project count, top project (largest single-vendor allocation). Click a vendor row to expand and see per-project allocations from that vendor.

**Category analysis:** per-cost-category rollup (Consulting / Cloud-Infrastructure / Licenses / Hardware / Other) showing absolute spend, % of total, and trend chart. Each category includes a `pct_of_external_total` ratio for fast scanning.

**Project × Vendor matrix:** rows = projects, columns = vendors, cells = €. Sparse; only populated cells render. Useful for spotting which vendors are concentrated in which projects.

**Backed by:** `services/portfolio_service.py` external-spend aggregator + `routers/portfolio.py::external_spend()`. v5 Cluster E Session E2 backend wiring.
